title: I like it
body: I like it it helps me and it’s fun way to keep track of things. But the thing is there’s not much things to do and things to get bamboo with so for example I’ve got 7 bamboo and the only quest there is that I can level up is to buy something for more than 50 bamboo and I think that’s pretty unfair because unless I do the quest there’s nothing else to do.

title: amazing app
body: i love this app to bits and pieces and it helps me out so much, but yesterday (26/06/25) it wouldn’t let me open the app no matter what i tried (changing wifi, using data etc.) so i deleted the app and redownloaded it but i lost all my progress (i had a full kitted bedroom and was on level 25 or something) because i didn’t know there was an option to backup data (fault on my part)
author: Yahoo235664475

title: Meh
body: I had really good expectations but this is quite boring. I wish it was more rewarding like an Actual game you win points with but has the added substance of motivating you to do your set tasks. Which is such a usp. The rewards are slow and not motivating at all. Also setting times for task under all tasks can’t be found in the morning afternoon or evening categories. luckily I didn’t pay full price for it.
author: I love cake and gym

title: Love this
body: Simple, easy to use. Took a few weeks to make using it a daily habit but now I find it much better than all the other apps I’ve tried. Have made real progress with my ADHD with this app.
author: Jellybet

title: Nice idea, poor execution
body: I like the concept and it’s loosely working in that I’ve been establishing new routines, but after 2 weeks the  app has reset and I’ve lost my progress and it’s not worth the effort to get back there again. The app is riddled with bugs and is very slow to move along in. Nice idea, poor execution.
author: Fennerer

title: Boring honestly
body: I like the aspect of the game but it’s kind of boring, i’ve been using it for over two weeks and the levelling up is pretty slow and there’s little reward for levelling up. Needs more choice of pets and items for the room and just a general reason to want to use it. I downloaded and paid for a month because i wanted something to make me feel rewarded for doing simple tasks and chores as someone with low motivation.
